decision: ADR-0004 bounded ancestry-aware packs with pack-level compression
implementation_status: Deferred physical packing/compression; no compressor or compressed pack reader is introduced by the minimal lossless history hard cut.
limitation: No cold-disk or decompression throughput, random-read granularity, peak decompression memory or vacuum result exists. ADR-0004 requires those measurements when packing/compression is implemented. Raw logical reductions are not attributed to compression.
